start: Settings, How the app picks your next weight; the member follows a plan

user_sees: Rows 'Weight step' (Standard, 'About 5% more each time') and 'Reps to aim for' (Match my goal)
A card 'Easy weeks' for the followed plan: 'In <plan>: every 6 weeks, half the sets at the same weights. Kept out of your records.'
must_not: Easy weeks shown for a plan the member does not follow

user_sees: Sheet 'Weight step' with the line about adding weight at the top of your reps and the gym's smallest plates; Small, Standard (Recommended), Large
The sheet closes; the row shows Large, 'About 10% more each time'; the next workout's Target goes up by about 10 percent at the top of the reps
must_not: The old step still used for the Target

user_sees: The switch stays on after the page is left and opened again
must_not: The switch flipping back with no message

start: Settings, How the app picks your next weight

steps.action: Tap 'Reps to aim for' and pick Strength
user_sees: Sheet with the help line and the note 'Match my goal keeps the range each exercise has in its routine. Any other choice sets the range for every exercise.'; row shows Strength
must_not: Routines' own ranges changed with Match my goal chosen

start: Workout tab, the followed plan's folder menu

steps.action: Tap ⋯ on the plan folder and use its Easy weeks shortcut, then open the settings page
user_sees: The same Easy weeks value on both
must_not: Two different values in the folder menu and in Settings

start: Settings, How the app picks your next weight

steps.action: Open the page while following no plan
user_sees: No Easy weeks switch; the line 'Easy weeks work only with a plan you follow. On the Workout tab, tap ⋯ on a folder, then "Follow this plan".'
must_not: An Easy weeks switch with nothing to apply to

steps.action: Follow a plan, turn Easy weeks on while the save fails
user_sees: Message 'Could not save' with 'Please try again.'; the switch shows the saved value
must_not: The switch showing on after a failed save

start: Settings page, Easy weeks on for the followed plan

user_sees: Off, and still off on return
must_not: Next week still an easy week

user_sees: On; the plan's next easy week comes back
must_not: The easy-week count restarted without a word

start: A gym whose smallest plates are set; the member does a barbell lift at the top of the reps

steps.action: Read the Weight step help line
user_sees: 'On barbell lifts we use your gym's smallest plates.'
must_not: A help line that is not kept

steps.action: Look at the next workout's Target on the barbell lift
user_sees: The Target rises by what the gym's smallest plates can load
must_not: A Target the gym's plates cannot make
